blind.description: A stylized pyramid stack of gold bullion bars / ingots. The stack is arranged in stepped layers tapering to two bars at the apex. Each bar has bevelled edges and a subtle circular stamp indentation on top. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and clean with warm golden-yellow and orange gradient shading.
blind.from_above: A square stepped pyramid configuration with concentric rectangular bars framing two central side-by-side gold bars, resembling an aerial view of a stepped ziggurat or stylized electronic chip.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-quarter the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 ft tall), and roughly 2 to 2.5 ft wide at the base.
